g.title: #1 PiFilterComponentsNotGrouped <PiFilterComponentsNotGrouped inductorName="L1" firstCapacitorName="C1" secondCapacitorName="C2" maxSignalPinDistance="5.529" maxRecommendedSignalPinDistance="4" message="Group C1 and C2 beside the connected ends of L1 so the series path and both grounded branches of the pi filter can be read together.
